WITH country_with_9_days AS (
  SELECT country_code_2
  FROM cities
  WHERE insert_date LIKE '2022-01-%'
  GROUP BY country_code_2
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT insert_date) = 9
),
distinct_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT insert_date,
         CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 9, 2) as INTEGER) as day_num
  FROM cities
  WHERE country_code_2 IN (SELECT country_code_2 FROM country_with_9_days) 
    AND insert_date LIKE '2022-01-%'
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    LAG(day_num) OVER (ORDER BY day_num) as prev_day
  FROM distinct_dates
),
with_marker AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    CASE WHEN prev_day IS NULL OR day_num - LAG(day_num) OVER (ORDER BY day_num) != 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_start_of_sequence
  FROM with_lag
),
with_sequence AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    SUM(is_start_of_sequence) OVER (ORDER BY day_num ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as seq_id
  FROM with_marker
),
sequence_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    seq_id,
    MIN(day_num) as start_day,
    MAX(day_num) as end_day,
    COUNT(*) as days_count
  FROM with_sequence
  GROUP BY seq_id
),
longest_consecutive_period AS (
  SELECT start_day, end_day, days_count
  FROM sequence_stats
  WHERE days_count = (SELECT MAX(days_count) FROM sequence_stats)
),
proportion_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_entries,
    SUM(CASE WHEN capital = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as capital_entries,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN capital = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) as proportion
  FROM cities
  WHERE country_code_2 IN (SELECT country_code_2 FROM country_with_9_days)
    AND insert_date LIKE '2022-01-%'
    AND CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN (SELECT start_day FROM longest_consecutive_period) 
      AND (SELECT end_day FROM longest_consecutive_period)
)
